abstract: Background: Anti-NMDA receptor (A-NMDAR) encephalitis is an autoimmune condition often associated with ovarian teratoma. Surgical removal of the teratoma is generally curative, and recurrence is uncommon. Case: A 14-year-old female presented with psychiatric symptoms and was ultimately diagnosed with A-NMDAR encephalitis during a prolonged hospitalization. She was found to have bilateral ovarian teratomas, underwent laparoscopic bilateral ovarian cystectomy, and returned to neurologic baseline within 2 months. One year later, the patient was re-presented with similar symptoms and was diagnosed with recurrent A-NMDAR encephalitis. Initial imaging was negative for ovarian teratomas. After another prolonged hospitalization, repeat imaging ultimately demonstrated a suspected left ovarian teratoma. A left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed, and the patient's condition again fully recovered. Conclusion: This case of A-NMDAR encephalitis presented with many atypical features including neuropsychiatric presenting symptoms, bilateral teratomas, and severe recurrence of disease. While imaging is the recommended modality for investigation of etiology, no teratoma was identified on the second presentation, leading to an ethical and clinical conundrum in this adolescent patient. More research is needed to investigate other diagnostic methods for A-NMDAR encephalitis without distinct teratoma on imaging in female patients.
abstract_ja: 【背景】抗NMDA受容体脳炎は卵巣奇形腫にしばしば関連する自己免疫疾患である。奇形腫の外科的除去は一般に根治的であり、再発は稀である。【症例】14歳の女児が精神症状で来院し、長期入院中に抗NMDA受容体脳炎と最終的に診断された。双側卵巣奇形腫が認められ、腹腔鏡下双側卵巣嚢胞摘出術を受け、2ヶ月以内に神経学的ベースラインに回復した。1年後、患者は同様の症状で再度来院し、再発性抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。初期画像検査では卵巣奇形腫が認められなかった。長期入院の後、繰り返し画像検査は疑わしい左卵巣奇形腫を最終的に明らかにした。左卵管卵巣摘除術を行い、患者の状態は再び完全に回復した。【結論】本症例の抗NMDA受容体脳炎は多くの非典型的特徴を示し、精神神経症状の初期症状、双側奇形腫、および重症な疾患再発が含まれた。画像検査は病因の検査に推奨されるモダリティであるが、第2回目の来院時には奇形腫が同定されず、この思春期患者における倫理的および臨床的ジレンマが生じた。女性患者における抗NMDA受容体脳炎の他の診断法を調査するためにより多くの研究が必要である。
